name: Reventor Page Shield
author: REVENTOR

sections.description:
Reventor Page Shield is a lightweight WordPress plugin that allows you to instantly protect any page from logged-out users with a single click. When enabled for a specific page, the plugin automatically redirects logged-out visitors to a safe destination. Search engines cannot crawl protected pages, ensuring the content remains hidden.

Features

  • One-click protection toggle inside the page settings.
  • Protection applies only to logged-out users.
  • Choose redirect behavior: Home URL or Custom URL.
  • Automatic redirect from original page to selected destination for logged-out users.
  • Prevents indexing by search engines.
  • No complex configuration.
  • Minimal and fast.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to any page editor to see the “Page Protection” meta box.
sections.faq:
Does this work for posts as well?

Currently, the plugin is designed to work with Pages. Support for other post types may be added in future versions.

Can I redirect to an external URL?

Yes, you can select “Custom URL” and enter any valid URL, including external ones.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with basic protection and redirect functionality for logged-out users.
  • Updated plugin name from “Secure Redirect” to “Reventor Page Shield” for better distinction and compliance with WordPress.org guidelines.
  • Updated text domain from “secure-redirect” to “reventor-page-shield”.
